details: Bitcoin surged towards $64,000 on July 6, recovering significantly from its recent lows. This rebound was largely driven by a weaker-than-expected US June jobs report, which reported only 57,000 new nonfarm payrolls, easing fears of further Federal Reserve interest rate hikes. This positive macroeconomic sentiment, combined with $221.72 million in net inflows into US spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) on July 2, ended a 10-day outflow streak and boosted investor confidence in risk assets.
title: Bitcoin Rallies as Weak US Jobs Data & ETF Inflows Fuel Recovery

details: Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin has outlined a comprehensive "Lean Ethereum" roadmap, a multi-year protocol overhaul deemed as significant as "The Merge." The plan, following a recent researcher meeting in Berlin, aims to replace nearly every major protocol component over the next three to four years. Key focus areas include enhancing quantum security, improving privacy features, enabling cheaper data storage solutions, and potentially introducing a new virtual machine to boost efficiency and scalability.
title: Vitalik Buterin Unveils Multi-Year "Lean Ethereum" Roadmap

details: On July 6, the BonkDAO treasury experienced a significant loss of approximately $20 million worth of BONK tokens due to a malicious governance proposal. Reports indicate that an attacker acquired $4 million in BONK to secure enough voting power, subsequently passing a proposal that diverted 4.426 billion BONK tokens to a wallet they controlled. The Bonk project has initiated contact with law enforcement agencies and is collaborating with exchanges and the Solana Foundation in an effort to recover the stolen funds. Following the incident, BONK's price saw a decline of about 7%.
title: BonkDAO Loses $20M in Malicious Governance Proposal Attack

details: Ripple has officially obtained full Crypto Asset Service Provider (CASP) authorization from Luxembourg's financial regulator, thereby fulfilling its Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation (MiCA) compliance. This crucial license enables Ripple to offer regulated crypto payments, custody services, and other related offerings across all 30 countries within the European Economic Area. This achievement positions Ripple among a select group of digital asset firms to have secured full MiCA authorization after the July 1 regulatory deadline.
title: Ripple Secures Full EU MiCA License for Crypto Payments
